title: Friend View
description:
Observe a friend's co-op play in Slay the Spire 2: combat, rewards, shops, dialogue, predictions, rest sites and supported card/relic selection screens. Treasure rooms deliberately disable Friend View until leaving.

[h2]Controls and settings[/h2]
Use the small eye beside a friend. Click again, click the observed avatar or use Esc / native controller Cancel to return. Disable Show Friend View Button to enter through avatars. When inactive observation is unavailable, normal player details remain available. Eyes appear together, disable when unavailable and fade with the scene.

Five settings with native English/Russian labels and explanations, all enabled by default: Show Friend View Button; Exit When All Turns End; Auto Watch After My Turn; Exit When Room Is Complete; Follow Combat Interactions. Automatic viewing follows unfinished players after your own turn. Disable Follow Combat to inspect/select mirrored cards independently without playing them. The old battle-only option is removed.

[h2]Your friend's perspective[/h2]
Native watched health, block, powers, Osty, Regent stars and Defect orbs; player-specific intent damage, stolen cards and target-aware card previews. Reward choices belong to the observed player. The header shows their portrait, health, gold, potions, relics and deck count with an icon-only badge. Card/potion arrows identify targets and consumed potions disappear.

Pile and deck inspection is independent: Back/Esc closes the inspection first. Settings preserve observation. The shared local map retains synchronized votes. Cross observation shows each player's underlying own screen, without recursion. You cannot play another player's cards, purchase items or claim rewards. Your native End Turn remains available.

[h2]Rendering and compatibility[/h2]
Supported activities render locally using installed assets and bounded state updates while watched, at most two detailed changes per second. No screenshots or desktop capture are transmitted. The decorative merchant hand is omitted; effect phases can differ. Unknown windows disable observation. Game updates and new rendering methods require validation.

All lobby members need matching game and mod versions. Use the built-in loader; avoid duplicate Workshop/manual installations. When Friend View is the sole successfully loaded cosmetic mod, the normal profile is used; otherwise native modded-profile isolation remains. No save copying or merging; MODDED stays visible. Native controller mappings and glyphs are respected.

Own code: MIT, developed with OpenAI Codex. Game assets belong to Mega Crit and are not redistributed.

All participants require 1.4.0. Intermittent pre-logo startup failure remains under investigation; see repository validation report before public release.
